chunks: Abu Sulayman Ahmad ibn Hawtha al-Bahili narrated to us, saying: Abu Ishaq Ibrahim ibn Ishaq an-Nahawandi narrated to us in Nahawand in the year 293 AH, saying: Abdullah ibn Hammad al-Ansari narrated to us in the month of Ramadan in the year 229 AH, from Abban ibn Uthman, who said: Abu Abdullah Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him) said:

While the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was in al-Baqi' one day, Ali (peace be upon him) came and asked about the Messenger of Allah. It was said to him that he was in al-Baqi'. So Ali went to him and greeted him. The Messenger of Allah said: 'Sit,' and seated him on his right. Then Ja'far ibn Abi Talib came and asked about the Messenger of Allah. It was said to him: 'He is in al-Baqi'.' So he went to him, greeted him, and the Prophet seated him on his left. Then al-Abbas came and asked about the Messenger of Allah. It was said to him: 'He is in al-Baqi'.' So he went to him, greeted him, and the Prophet seated him in front of him.

Then the Messenger of Allah turned to Ali and said: 'Shall I give you good news? Shall I inform you, O Ali?' He said: 'Yes, O Messenger of Allah.' He said: 'Gabriel was with me a moment ago and informed me that the Qa'im who will appear at the end of time will fill the earth with justice, as it was filled with oppression and tyranny, from your progeny, from the descendants of al-Husayn.' Ali said: 'O Messenger of Allah, whatever goodness has befallen us from Allah has been through your hands.'

Then the Messenger of Allah turned to Ja'far ibn Abi Talib and said: 'O Ja'far, shall I give you good news? Shall I inform you?' He said: 'Yes, O Messenger of Allah.' He said: 'Gabriel was with me a moment ago and informed me that the one who will deliver the banner to the Qa'im is from your progeny. Do you know who he is?' He said: 'No.' He said: 'It is he whose face is like a dinar, whose teeth are like a saw, and whose sword is like a flame of fire. He will enter the ranks lowly and come out of them noble, surrounded by Gabriel and Michael.'

Then he turned to al-Abbas and said: 'O uncle of the Prophet, shall I inform you of what Gabriel informed me?' He said: 'Yes, O Messenger of Allah.' He said: 'Gabriel said to me: Woe to your progeny from the descendants of al-Abbas.' He said: 'O Messenger of Allah, should I avoid women?' He said to him: 'Allah has already determined what will happen.'

key_terms.الذَّرِّيَّة: Progeny/Descendants, referring to the family of the Prophet.
key_terms.الْبَقِيع: Al-Baqi', a cemetery in Medina where the Prophet and his companions were often found.
key_terms.الْعَبَّاس: Al-Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib, the uncle of the Prophet.
key_terms.الْقَائِم: The Qa'im (The Riser/Awaited One), a title for the Twelfth Imam in Shia eschatology.
key_terms.جِبْرِئِيل: Gabriel, the archangel who delivers divine revelations.
key_terms.يَدْفَعُهَا: He delivers it (the banner/standard), referring to the specific role of Ja'far's descendant.

ai.seo_question: Who is the descendant of Ja'far ibn Abi Talib that will deliver the banner to the Qa'im, and what is the significance of al-Abbas's lineage in this prophecy?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Nu'mani’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights the theological significance of the Prophet’s gathering with Ali, Ja'far, and al-Abbas in al-Baqi', where Gabriel reveals the lineage of the al-Qa'im specifically from Husayn’s progeny. It further identifies a distinct descendant of Ja'far ibn Abi Talib, characterized by unique physical and spiritual traits, as the standard-bearer who will pave the way for the Mahdi’s appearance. The narration also foreshadows the tribulations awaiting the Abbasid line, reinforcing the Shia narrative of political and spiritual succession.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (1) Abu Sulayman Ahmad bin Hawtha al-Bahili narrated from Abu Iss’haq Ibraheem bin Iss’haq an-Nahawandi from Abdullah bin Hammad al-Ansari from Abban bin Uthman that Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as) had said:

“One day while the Prophet (S) was in al-Baqee,’ Ali (as) came and asked where the Prophet (S) was. It was said to him that he had been in al-Baqee’. Ali (as) went to al-Baqee’. He greeted the Prophet (S) and the Prophet (S) asked him to sit down on his right hand. Then Ja’far bin Abu Talib (Ali’s brother) came and greeted the Prophet (S). The Prophet (S) asked him to sit down on his left. Then al-Abbas (the Prophet’s uncle) came, greeted the Prophet (S) and the Prophet (S) seated him before him.

The Prophet (S) turned to Ali (as) and said: “O Ali, shall I tell you of good news?” Ali (as) said: “Yes please, O messenger of Allah.” The Prophet (S) said: “Gabriel has just been with me a moment ago. He has told me that al-Qa’im, who will appear at the end of time and fill the world with justice after it will have been filled with injustice and oppression, will be from your progeny and from the descendants of al-Husayn.” Ali said: “O messenger of Allah, whatever goodness we have gotten from Allah is by means of you.”

Then the Prophet (S) turned to Ja’far bin Abu Talib and said: “O Ja’far, shall I tell you of good news?” Ja’far said: “Yes please, O messenger of Allah.” The Prophet (S) said to Ja’far: “Gabriel has just been with me and told me that the one, who will deliver the banner to al-Qa’im, will be from your progeny. Do you know who he is?” Ja’far said: “No, I do not.” The Prophet (S) said: “It is he, whose face will be like a dinar, whose teeth will be like a saw and whose sword will be like a flame of fire. He will enter into the mountain lowly and will come out of it nobly surrounded by Gabriel and Michael.”

Then the Prophet (S) turned to al-Abbas and said to him: “O the uncle of the Prophet, shall I tell you of what Gabriel has told me?” Al-Abbas said: “Yes please, O messenger of Allah.” The Prophet (S) said: “Gabriel said to me: How much distresses your progeny will receive from the progeny of al-Abbas!” Al-Abbas said: “O messenger of Allah, do I avoid sleeping with women?” The Prophet (S) said: “Allah has already determined what will happen.”
